human_tolerance.notes: Forest-interior bird; uses mature deciduous or mixed forest with a shaded understory and leaf litter.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Breeds in eastern North America; dates are broad authored seasonal bounds.

phases.name: absent
phases.note: Migrates from the US to wintering grounds in Mexico and Central America; broad authored bounds.

vocalizations.description: Male gives a clear, flute-like territorial song from a perch during the breeding season.
Sharp alarm notes are given when disturbed.

slug.note: Lowercase scientific name with a hyphen.

external.note: GBIF usage key 2490872 is accepted species Hylocichla mustelina; iNaturalist taxon 13270 is the accepted species taxon.

range.note: Breeding range in southern Canada and the United States; winter range in southern Mexico through Panama.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Diet section states hopping on leaf litter; powered flight is described in migration and behavior sections.

traits.lifespan_y.note: The CSV's survival=0.447 is annual apparent adult survival for a US MAPS mark-recapture sample (row 239, citing Desante et al. 2015), not a lifespan. 2.8 y is an approximate stationary geometric-survival proxy: 1 year to first reproduction plus 1/(1-0.447)=1.81 expected adult years. It assumes constant annual apparent survival and ignores age-specific and juvenile mortality; it should not be read as a measured typical lifespan.

traits.social.note: Primarily solitary, with pair bonds during breeding; group-size range is a judgement.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Foraging and song are daytime/twilight behaviors; migration at night does not make ordinary activity nocturnal.

traits.defense.note: Flee is a simplified simulation response based on reported alarm and nest-defense behavior.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement; described as reclusive and a forest-interior bird.

habitat.note: Forest habitat, leaf-litter foraging and understory behavior from Habitat and Diet sections; proportions and resource weights are authored estimates.

seasonal.note: Distribution and habitat section describes migration to Mexico/Central America; phase dates are authored broad bounds.

activity.note: US activity observations are fetched below.

behavior.note: Species-local tree behavior fits ground leaf-litter hopping and eating invertebrates, adds berry feeding in August through February, gates song to dawn/dusk during April through July, builds cup nests April through July, and roosts on a perch at night. Parameters and simplified responses are authored.

vocalizations.note: Sections Vocalization and Behavior describe male song and alarm calls.

look.note: Palette follows the Description section's cinnamon-brown upperparts, white underparts and dark spotting; proportions are authored for the stylized mesh.
